info.title: NTC NVIDIA VSS Retail Unified Workspace
info.description: Phase 15 NVIDIA VSS UI integration API. The browser uses only this loopback same-origin gateway. Fixed internal adapters expose camera presentation, analytics, alerts, selected media, semantic search, summarization, grounded Q&A and reports without exposing arbitrary upstream URLs. Phase 15 remains PARTIAL; Phase 14 remains LOCKED_BY_USER and Phase 08 remains deferred.

200.description: Partial-failure-tolerant workspace bootstrap and system snapshot

get.description: Credential-free VIOS stream inventory; source URLs and credentials are never returned.

post.description: Registers one RTSP source in VIOS. The gateway does not persist or return the submitted URL.

get.description: Same-origin MJPEG presentation stream. Currently capability-allowlisted only for cam-01. The video plane remains independent from AI admission.

put.description: Updates only the existing queue thresholds with an incremented config_version. Connection, secret, RTSP and arbitrary URL fields are rejected.

get.description: Exact-ID selected-media endpoint. IDs must first be observed in an allowlisted workflow response. A single byte range is supported.

post.description: Evidence-first routing for one exact clip, alert or summary. Resolves allowlisted selected media, reuses an exact completed summary or creates a persisted selected-clip job. This operation never invokes semantic search and never switches a GPU profile.

get.description: Plays an exact selected-media asset only when it belongs to the exact report and store.

200.description: Staging media preview; this is not Store media

409.description: RT-CV file batch adapter or candidate is unavailable

post.description: Safe local assistant adapter. Browser-supplied completion URLs are ignored and no GPU profile is started automatically.
Transforms the NVIDIA Search screen contract into the versioned workspace semantic-search contract.

get.description: Lists real-time alert rules for the NVIDIA Real-time Alerts screen. Query parameters are rejected. Listing never starts or admits a VLM. Delegated only to the fixed loopback VSS Alert Verification service (pinned 3.2.0 tag shipped with VSS 3.2.1). Rule persistence is disabled in this overlay, so rule state is not durable.

post.description: Creates a real-time alert rule. Requires tools:execute, a same-origin JSON body of at most 256 KiB, and is audited including rejected or failed attempts. Returns realtime_provider_unavailable (502) while the admitted Cosmos3/RTVI provider is not running. Delegated only to the fixed loopback VSS Alert Verification service (pinned 3.2.0 tag shipped with VSS 3.2.1). Rule persistence is disabled in this overlay, so rule state is not durable.

get.description: Reads one real-time alert rule. Delegated only to the fixed loopback VSS Alert Verification service (pinned 3.2.0 tag shipped with VSS 3.2.1). Rule persistence is disabled in this overlay, so rule state is not durable.

delete.description: Deletes one real-time alert rule. Requires tools:execute, a same-origin request and an empty JSON object body; audited. Delegated only to the fixed loopback VSS Alert Verification service (pinned 3.2.0 tag shipped with VSS 3.2.1). Rule persistence is disabled in this overlay, so rule state is not durable.

get.description: Transforms existing versioned alert records for the NVIDIA Alerts screen.
Credential-free stable camera and VST sensor identity inventory.
Credential-free reference inventory for Video Management cards.
Bounded VST timeline inventory used only for media selection and presentation.
Selects a bounded VST clip and returns a sanitized same-origin presentation URL.
Presents only a VST-generated allowlisted MP4 filename and supports a single byte range.

Forbidden.description: The current role lacks the required permission

managed_job_id.description: Optional exact Phase 13 job that owns this GPU window. When supplied, the host worker restores realtime after the stage checkpoint.

auto_restore.description: Required with managed_job_id; never enables a profile without confirmation.
